jobs.title: Product Owner Locker.OS
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Product Owner at GLS/NXT to drive a new product pillar's roadmap within the out-of-home (OOH) Platform, serving our international GLS markets and partner ecosystem. In this role, you will translate the strategy for the Locker.OS pillar into a clear, prioritized backlog, define requirements, and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship the right things in the right order.

Locker.OS is a GLS/NXT initiative to build a standardized, scalable, and secure software stack that powers GLS parcel lockers.

You are accountable for delivery of your pillar: you own the backlog end to end, make the day-to-day decisions that keep engineering unblocked, and turn stakeholder feedback into concrete, well-scoped work bringing structure and clarity in close partnership with the engineering team.

You will also work closely with the support team, so that complex problems are resolved and recurring themes feed back into product discovery. As part of the GLS/NXT OOH Team, you will drive sprint planning, reviews, and other team rituals for your pillar.

This role is perfect for someone who is structured, curious, and motivated by building great products, comfortable prioritizing under real-world constraints and turning user and stakeholder insights into meaningful improvements, while making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Tasks

  • Drive delivery of the roadmap for one product pillar of our OOH parcel locker platform, translating strategic priorities into a clear, prioritized backlog
  • Write and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements, keeping the backlog refined and ready for delivery
  • Prioritize work by balancing user needs, business value, technical constraints, and stakeholder input, and communicate those trade-offs transparently
  • Partner closely with engineers and designers to deliver against the roadmap, resolving ambiguity and making the day-to-day product decisions that keep delivery moving
  • Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and other agile rituals for your product pillar
  • Translate stakeholder and market feedback into structured, actionable product insights for product discovery
  • Collaborate with customer support to ensure complex issues are resolved and recurring patterns feed back into your backlog
  • Track and report key product metrics for your pillar, surfacing trends and insights that inform prioritization and roadmap decisions
  • Maintain clear documentation of requirements, workflows, known issues, and product decisions

Requirements

What you bring

  • >4 years of experience in product management/ownership, integration, implementation or technical project management in B2B
  • Experience owning a backlog and writing clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria within agile software delivery (sprint planning, backlog refinement, product rituals)
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a structured approach to problem-solving and prioritization
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and cultures
  • A low-ego, hands-on mentality with a strong bias for getting things done, and curiosity for trying new tools and approaches, including AI, to improve how we work
  • Fundamental understanding of technical concepts such as APIs, system architecture, or digital platform products
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  • Valid working permit for Germany

Nice to have

  • Experience with products that combine hardware and software, for example connected devices, IoT, or embedded systems.
  • Previous experience in logistics is a plus
  • German language skills are welcome but not required
  • Comfort working with tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project tracking tools

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

Benefits

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow
  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday
  • Reward system: Rewards for the recommendation of additional team members

About GLS NXT:

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Radiotech)
jobs.description:
About us

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide, moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys.

Headquartered in London, Gismart is a global company with a team of 400+ people across Europe and beyond. We bring together professionals from entertainment, music, and tech backgrounds, combining creativity, product thinking, and strong execution to build apps used by millions of people worldwide.

Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values

  • Deliver what matters

  • Respect and support others

  • Initiate and own

  • Voice openly

  • Execute with quality

If you are passionate about mobile products and want to work on apps with real scale, Gismart is the right place to grow, take ownership, and make an impact.


About the project

At Radiotech, we believe music should be accessible to everyone — not only to those who grew up taking lessons.

We are a product team inside the Gismart ecosystem, focused on building and growing music apps across iOS and Android. Our portfolio includes products with millions of installs, rich functionality, and a long history of product development. These are apps that help users not only consume music content, but also play, learn, practice, create, interact, and enjoy the process.

Our goal is to make music feel more approachable, engaging, and human for beginners, hobbyists, and people who want to bring more music into their daily lives.

We are looking for a Product Manager who will not wait for perfectly detailed instructions, but will proactively identify opportunities, take ownership, and move the product forward together with the team.


Responsibilities

  • Own the user journey from the first purchase to the end of the customer lifetime

  • Identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and LTV

  • Work with mobile app functionality, onboarding, paywalls, subscription mechanics, content flows, learning flows, and engagement loops

  • Build and prioritize the product roadmap together with leadership, design, engineering, analytics, marketing, and creative teams

  • Run product discovery through user behavior analysis, market research, competitor analysis, support feedback, and product analytics

  • Write clear product specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and experiment briefs

  • Launch and analyze A/B tests across onboarding, paywalls, pricing, retention, engagement, and monetization

  • Track product metrics, build conclusions from data, and make ship / iterate / kill decisions

  • Collaborate with UA, PMM, creative, ASO, and growth teams to improve the full funnel from acquisition to long-term retention

  • Proactively identify problems and act without waiting for detailed instructions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience in B2C mobile products

  • Hands-on experience with iOS and/or Android app development processes

  • Strong understanding of subscription or freemium monetization models

  • Proven experience improving product metrics such as conversion, retention, LTV, ARPU, ARPPU, churn, activation, or engagement

  • Experience working with mobile product teams: engineers, designers, QA, analytics, marketing, and product leadership

  • Strong analytical skills: funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention analysis, A/B testing, and experiment interpretation

  • Ability to work with ambiguity, define priorities, and move initiatives forward independently

  • Experience writing clear product requirements and leading initiatives through the full lifecycle: discovery, release, analysis, and iteration

  • English level sufficient for working with international teams and analyzing global market references

Hiring process:

  • Screening

  • Test Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Final interview


Employee Benefits:

  • Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs

  • Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace

  • Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday

  • Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year

  • 100% Sick Leave Compensation

  • Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs

  • Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools

  • Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses

  • Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart

  • Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You will define product solutions, scope, and success metrics for content-rich, UX-heavy customer journeys, and you will drive measurable improvements in storefront performance such as add-to-cart and checkout conversion. Working closely with UX, development, analytics, performance marketing, and country teams, you will structure complex product information into clear, attractive pages that reflect a premium brand experience.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, building a collaborative international team along the way.

What You'll Do

• Own eCommerce product initiatives from concept to launch and optimization, defining scope, risks, requirements, and success metrics.

• Conduct product discovery through user research, competitor analysis, usability testing, and synthesizing customer feedback into product decisions.

• Create page concepts, wireframes, prototypes, copy drafts, and visual briefs, and write clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

• Plan delivery with development, managing priorities, dependencies, QA, releases, rollout logic, toggles, and rollback plans.

• Monitor launches and use analytics, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive rapid fixes and follow-up improvements to storefront performance.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years in product management for eCommerce products, with strong experience in UX-heavy, content-rich customer journeys.

• Proven ability to structure complex product information into clear, simple, and attractive pages, backed by customer research and insight-driven decisions.

• Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes a premium digital brand experience, plus the ability to create concepts, wireframes, and copy drafts independently.

• Solid command of CRO, analytics, A/B testing, and storefront performance optimization, and a track record of aligning UX, developers, analytics, and marketing.

• Nice to have: experience with Shopify or other storefront platforms, high-ticket or considered-purchase eCommerce, premium/lifestyle brands, and building repeatable product processes or templates.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary that reflects your expertise and rewards results · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take on real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

• Team culture with regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats

• Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

• Jobrad / bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin, Germany

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.

You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.

Outcomes

Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.

  • Customer adoption of shipped work: Usage and adoption rates of new and materially updated capabilities within our target ICP.

  • Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.

  • Customer and business impact: Expansion revenue, win rate, retention, and customer value creation attributable to your product work.

  • Cross-functional coherence: Engineering, Research, and GTM operating from one shared reality about what matters most, and why.

  • Strategic contribution: Bets you've brought to the table, backed by customer conviction and market insight, that shaped the roadmap beyond your own surface.

Responsibilities | What you will own...

  • Own a Meaningful Product Surface End-to-End
    Drive the full lifecycle of your product surface, from discovery to delivery to adoption. Write crisp specs, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner with engineering. Own outcomes, not outputs. At this level, we expect you to define the surface you’re working on in addition to executing against it.

  • Build Direct Customer Intuition
    Spend meaningful, consistent time with customers. Work alongside our PhD-level Researchers, but bring your own developed point of view on how users and buyers at Fortune 1000 brands think, what they need, and where the market is moving.

  • Make AI-Native Product Decisions
    Own the AI layer of your surface: eval strategies, quality loops, failure-mode design, when to trust the model versus defer to humans. This is what separates us from AI-washed research tools, and you'll help us defend and extend that gap.

  • Operate as a Force Multiplier Across R&D and GTM
    Drive clarity on tradeoffs, eliminate mid-stream thrash, and ensure Engineering, Research, and GTM are working from one shared reality about what matters and why. At this level, we expect you to create alignment.

  • Contribute to Company-Level Decisions & Roadmap
    Your impact should reach well beyond what you ship. Bring bets to the betting table backed by real customer conviction, competitive insight, and business judgment. Weigh in on how we plan quarters, how we position against competitors, and how we tell our story to customers. See your bets through with evidence, judgment, and taste.

Required Skills & Experiences

Required:

You understand evals, hallucination management, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure-mode design — even if you didn't write the eval code yourself. You use AI tools fluently in your own PM work to draft, prototype, research, and design. You have a real, developed point of view on how the PM role is changing in an AI-native world.

  • Strong technical fluency. Comfortable driving real conversations with senior engineers about architecture, tradeoffs, and constraints — not just translating between them.

  • Strategic range. You've operated beyond your own surface and influenced roadmap direction, contributed to company-level planning, and shaped how your org thinks about a market. You have opinions that change what gets built, and you back them with evidence.

Nice to Haves

  • Background operating in a senior IC role in a flat, founder-led environment.

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

THE LAST FRONTIER

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.

You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

  • Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

  • Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

  • Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

  • Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.

  • Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.

  • Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.

  • Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.

  • Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.

  • Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.

  • 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.

  • Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.

  • Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.

  • A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.

DESIRABLE SKILLS

  • Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock)

  • Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design

  • Basic understanding of RF systems and components

  • Previous experience working within an R&D workshop

  • Experience with satellite communications, RF hardware, or Arctic/extreme-environment systems.

  • Familiarity with export control considerations (ITAR/EAR, UK export licensing) relevant to dual-use technology.

  • Experience working with or alongside defence primes, MOD, or NATO procurement processes.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience and Defect Elimination
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the role

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.

This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.

What you'll be doing

  • You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
  • You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
  • You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
  • You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.

Our humble expectations

  • The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
  • Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
  • There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
  • The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues. 

This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.

Next steps

You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role. The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.

You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).

This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on three priorities.

1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health

  • Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
  • Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
  • Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
  • Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.

2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation

  • Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
  • Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
  • Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
  • Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.

3. Benchmark Reports and Growth

  • This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
  • Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.

4. PPC Management and Optimization

  • Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
  • Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
  • Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
  • Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
  • Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
  • Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
  • Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
  • A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
  • Experience building benchmark reports or original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems
  • B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
  • Experience with PPC management and optimization

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

Bei der Impower GmbH entwickeln wir die Zukunft der Immobilienverwaltung – einfach, schnell und digital. Über 100.000 Menschen verwalten mehr als 12 Millionen Wohnungen mit Prozessen, die oft noch manuell, komplex und zeitaufwendig sind. Wir unterstützen Hausverwaltungen dabei, diese Abläufe Schritt für Schritt zuverlässig zu digitalisieren – mit klaren Strukturen, moderner Software und echtem Praxisnutzen.

Damit unser Unternehmen weiter wachsen kann, braucht es eine moderne, sichere und skalierbare interne IT. Als System Engineer baust du unsere interne IT-Funktion von Grund auf mit auf und entwickelst eine moderne, sichere und automatisierte IT-Landschaft, die das Wachstum unseres Unternehmens langfristig unterstützt.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du unsere Workplace- und Identity-Infrastruktur, gestaltest unsere SaaS-Landschaft und treibst Automatisierungen sowie moderne Security-Standards voran. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem CTO zusammen und schaffst die technologische Grundlage für effiziente interne Prozesse und eine hervorragende Employee Experience.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Landschaft mit Fokus auf Workplace, Identity Management, Security und SaaS-Systeme

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Employee Lifecycle – von IT-Onboarding und Offboarding bis zur Bereitstellung von Geräten, Accounts, Zugriffsrechten und Support

  • Aufbau und Betrieb eines modernen Mobile Device Managements inklusive Endpoint Security, Patch-Management und Asset Lifecycle

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Identity- und Security-Plattform (SSO, SCIM, MFA, Berechtigungsmanagement) sowie Umsetzung moderner Security-Standards und IT-Richtlinien

  • Entwicklung von Automatisierungen und Integrationen zwischen internen Systemen zur Reduzierung manueller Prozesse sowie Nutzung moderner AI-gestützter Workflows zur Steigerung der Effizienz

  • Verantwortung für die Auswahl, Konsolidierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Landschaft inklusive Lizenz-, Vendor- und Lifecycle-Management                                                                    

  • Mitarbeit an Compliance- und Audit-Initiativen (z. B. ISO 27001 und DSGVO) sowie Sicherstellung einer sicheren, skalierbaren und zukunftsfähigen internen IT-Infrastruktur


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als System Engineer, IT Administrator oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Verantwortung für interne IT-Systeme

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Workplace Management, Identity & Access Management sowie moderner SaaS- und Cloud-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung mit Mobile Device Management (z. B. Jamf), Endpoint Security sowie der Administration von Apple- oder modernen Workplace-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Automatisierungen und Integrationen zwischen IT-Systemen sowie Interesse daran, AI-gestützte Workflows sinnvoll einzusetzen

  • Gute Kenntnisse moderner IT-Sicherheitskonzepte wie Zero Trust, MFA, Least Privilege und Security Policies sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit ISO 27001 oder DSGVO

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern                                                                                                                 

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Team


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID oder vergleichbaren Identity-Plattformen

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Infrastructure as Code, Scripting oder Workflow-Automatisierung

  • Erfahrung mit iPaaS-Lösungen oder Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau interner IT-Strukturen in einem Scale-up oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen 

  • Interesse daran, perspektivisch ein kleines Internal IT Engineering Team aufzubauen


Warum wir?

  • Die Chance, die interne IT eines stark wachsenden PropTech-Scale-ups von Grund auf mitzugestalten

  • Direkter Einfluss auf Workplace, Security, Automatisierung und die digitale Arbeitsumgebung des gesamten Unternehmens

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO sowie hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Technologien, Prozessen und Tools

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit freier Hardware-Wahl (Mac oder Windows)

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell – arbeite bis zu drei Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro und flexibel remote

  • Ein diverses, motiviertes und agiles Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen                                     

  • Persönliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sowie die Perspektive, die interne IT-Funktion langfristig auszubauen

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

 

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Flexibility team.

The Flexibility team was established in early 2026, and has been growing throughout the year. The team is focused on greenfield opportunities at the cutting edge of Octopus' flexibility strategy, and aims to enable rapid response to global flex opportunities.

They are building the next generation of products and tools to make energy more flexible. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. The team develops products that are used by millions of customers, helping boost renewables use and decarbonise energy systems worldwide.

We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity. 

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.


What you'll do

  • Acting as the flexibility team’s first frontend engineer, establish the team’s frontend capability, lead the team’s frontend technical direction and represent the team to the cross-team community of frontend engineers

  • Build and own a diverse range of customer-facing user journeys, enabling customers to onboard, control, and analyse their low carbon tech

  • Build and own internal-facing interfaces for stakeholder-collaborators and experimental prototypes

  • Interface with established mobile teams by providing WebViews for emerging mobile customer journeys 

  • Collaborate with our internal design team to integrate our designs into the wider Octopus design system ‘Coral’

  • Carry out product discovery by working closely with our Product Manager and stakeholders from across the organisation

  • Build highly reusable interfaces that enable rapid response to new opportunities


    • What you'll have
  • 5+ years of experience with our stack (listed below)

  • Experience taking problems, rather than strict guidelines, and developing strong solutions

  • Confidence owning the development cycle (request, requirements gathering, technical proposal, technical execution, deployment and monitoring.)

  • Confidence tackling large-scale tasks individually

  • An empathetic approach to delegating work and collaborating with others

  • The ability to develop websites that meet strong accessibility guidelines

  • Experience building scalable, performant sites that handle high levels of traffic well

  • Desirable: energy domain knowledge


    • Our stack

  • React (required)

  • TypeScript (required)

  • Next.js on Vercel (desirable)

  • GraphQL w/ Tanstack Query (desirable)

  • React Testing Library & vitest and/or msw (desirable)

    • We have a preference for candidates who can work hybrid from our London office, but we're open to fully remote candidates (you do need to be based in the UK).


    Why else you'll love it here

    • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first 🚀
     
    P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at ----- and we’d love to help!
     
    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

jobs.title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

 

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.
  • Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Behörden, Netzbetreibern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Koordination der internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.
  • Projektabschluss und Übergabe: Vorbereitung der Projekte für Finanzierung, Vermarktung, Verkauf oder Übergabe in die Bau- und Realisierungsphase.

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im technischen oder energiewirtschaftlichen Umfeld.
  • Berufserfahrung in der Projektentwicklung im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, der Netzintegration oder der Netzanschlussplanung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer- und Grundkenntnisse netztechnischer Anforderungen.
  • Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starkes Schnittstellenmanagement.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf professionellem Niveau sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

  • Flexibler Arbeitsort: Du hast die Möglichkeit, remote von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich steht dir unser modernes und nachhaltiges Büro in Berlin-Südkreuz zur Verfügung, das eine gute Anbindung und eine angenehme Arbeitsumgebung bietet.
  • IT-Ausstattung: Wir stellen dir einen Laptop, Monitor, Kopfhörer und, falls erforderlich, ein Diensthandy zur Verfügung.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Deine Zeit ist wertvoll! Gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel, damit du persönliche Termine wahrnehmen, früher ins Wochenende starten oder einfach das Leben besser mit der Arbeit in Einklang bringen kannst. Du entscheidest.
  • Spendit Card: Monatlich 50 € zusätzlich zum Gehalt, die du für dein tägliches Mittagessen nutzen oder unbegrenzt ansparen kannst.
  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelung: Genieße 31 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, um dich zu erholen, neue Energie zu tanken und die Welt zu entdecken.
  • Onboarding: Mit einem strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess sorgen wir für einen reibungslosen Start und begleiten dich von Tag eins an, damit du dich gut aufgehoben fühlst.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir leisten einen monatlichen Beitrag von 13,29 € zu deiner Altersvorsorge.
  • Versicherungsschutz: Unfall- und Lebensversicherung sind inklusive – für deine Sicherheit und ein gutes Gefühl, sowohl im Job als auch privat.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Über unser Corporate Benefits-Programm erhältst du exklusive Rabatte auf zahlreiche Marken und Produkte.
  • Firmenwagen: Falls du berechtigt bist und dein Job es erfordert, steht dir ein Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement: Deine Gesundheit steht an erster Stelle! Profitiere von unserem Gesundheitsmanagement, inklusive Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, um fit und leistungsfähig zu bleiben.

Möchtest du Teil von Q ENERGY werden?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Bitte teile uns dabei deine Gehaltsvorstellung sowie dein frühestmögliches Startdatum mit.

Hinweis: Wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze für deine Bewerbung den „Jetzt bewerben“-Button. Vielen Dank!

Bei Fragen steht dir unser Recruiting-Team gerne zur ----- ENERGY ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen – bei uns arbeiten Menschen aus verschiedenen Nationen, Kulturen und Standorten partnerschaftlich zusammen und tauschen ihre Erfahrungen und Werte in einer offenen und kollegialen Atmosphäre aus.

jobs.description:
Dunetrace is looking for a Technical Co-Founder / CTO to join us in building the infrastructure layer for reliable AI agents.

AI agents are rapidly moving from prototypes into production. As they become more autonomous, companies need new infrastructure to understand what agents are doing, detect failures, enforce policies, and automatically recover from problems.

Dunetrace is a VC-backed, Berlin-based, open-source startup focused on runtime reliability, and control for AI agents. We’re building technology that helps developers detect, understand, prevent, and fix agent failures in production.

The Role

As Technical Co-Founder / CTO, you will be a core technical leader of Dunetrace and will have significant ownership over our technology, architecture, product, and engineering direction.

This is a hands-on founding role. We’re looking for someone who wants to build the product and the engineering organization from the ground up.

You will work closely with the founder and customers to determine what we build, how we build it, and where Dunetrace can establish a significant technical advantage.

Tasks

  • Own the overall technical vision and architecture of Dunetrace
  • Build and ship core product and infrastructure
  • Design scalable systems for AI agent reliability, and runtime control
  • Work on areas including agent execution, telemetry, evaluation, detection, policies, and automated remediation
  • Make key decisions around architecture, infrastructure, APIs, developer experience, and security
  • Work closely with early customers and translate their problems into product and technical solutions
  • Help shape the open-source project and developer community
  • Recruit and build the engineering team as the company grows
  • Help define Dunetrace's long-term technical strategy and roadmap

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building production systems
  • Deep understanding of backend systems, distributed systems, APIs, and infrastructure
  • Strong coding ability and a willingness to remain hands-on
  • Experience taking products from early-stage development to production
  • Strong technical judgment and ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions
  • High ownership and comfort operating in an early-stage startup environment
  • Genuine interest in AI agents and the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure ecosystem

Candidates should be based in Germany or willing to relocate to Germany. Previous founder/co-founder or early-stage startup experience is strongly preferred.

Experience with one or more of the following is a strong plus:

  • AI agents and agentic frameworks
  • AI/LLM observability
  • Distributed systems and developer infrastructure
  • OpenTelemetry or related observability technologies

Benefits

  • Significant co-founder equity with vesting
  • Competitive salary, based on experience
  • Full ownership of technical direction
  • Remote-first working environment in Germany

If you're excited about building the infrastructure that makes AI agents reliable in production, we'd love to hear from you.

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.


What You'll Do

  • Build the GTM playbook
    You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.


Who We're Looking For

  • 4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close.

  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.

  • Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.

  • Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.

  • Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

Tier A: OTE $240,000 – $280,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.
