jobs.title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation: $25 – $35 per hour

  • • $25 – $35 per hour

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive

jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You operate our Debezium-based change data capture pipelines, overseeing connectors, snapshots, offsets, replica lag, and BigQuery sink loaders 
  • You run our workloads on Kubernetes, including Navarch - our self-built workflow orchestrator executing ~7,500 SQL and Python tasks daily - owning resource management, autoscaling, and debugging

  • You act as a senior sparring partner alongside two senior data engineers (reporting to the Head of Data & Analytics) - driving design reviews and multi-quarter initiatives, with room to grow into BigQuery architecture over time: access frameworks, partitioning and slot strategy, the pipelines and models on top

You have run systems that broke, can explain what went wrong and how you permanently fixed it, and can detail a specific trade-off you navigated backed by concrete numbers

  • You thrive in a low-process, Kanban-driven environment where seniors self-organize, rotate weekly triage duties without micro-management, and prefer automating recurring requests over manually repeating them
  • Optional: You bring skills or interest in object-oriented design, data modeling/dbt, BigQuery architecture, orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster), stream processing (Beam, Flink, Spark), or internal automation (n8n, AI triage bots).

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Munich, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers across the DACH region. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

  • Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Europe, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

  • Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

  • Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

  • Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

  • Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices.

  • Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises.

  • Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.

  • Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact.

  • Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers.

  • Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements.

  • Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Are comfortable leading across European markets from London and adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models.

  • Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership.

  • Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI.

jobs.title: Publishing Product Director
jobs.description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team

Job Description About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

Reports to: Director of Sales

Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.

We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.

This role runs in two gears: sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.

In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle. From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.

What You'll Be Selling

  • Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid. We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale.

    • What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.

  • ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer, and a second motion alongside SSC.

What You’ll Do

  • Relentless Prospecting: Execute high-volume daily outbound campaigns (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to hunt for net-new opportunities and consistently book discovery meetings.

  • Full-Cycle Ownership: Run the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and aggressive qualification to running product demos, sending proposals, and closing deals.

  • Data-Driven Pipeline Triage: Actively manage your sales funnel within HubSpot, performing regular pipeline reviews to prioritize high-value opportunities and ruthlessly cut weak leads.

  • Drive Revenue & Velocity: Take absolute ownership of your targets, driving urgency in deal cycles to progress opportunities through late-stage negotiations and contract signing.

  • Hit Major Milestones: Our sales cycle runs four to six months, so your first quarter is about building. Deliver $175–300K in qualified pipeline (approx. 20–30 qualified meetings) in your first 90 days, and close your first net-new deal within six months.

  • Iterate & Optimize: Continuously refine your outreach messaging and campaign targeting based on performance metrics to maximize conversion rates.



What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 3+ Years of B2B Sales Experience: A proven track record of exceeding quotas in a full-cycle B2B sales or business development role (prospecting through to close).

  • "Hunter" Mentality & Dialing Discipline: You have a high drive, resilience in the face of rejection, and a proven daily discipline for outbound cold calling.

  • Pipeline Mastery: Strong proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) paired with immaculate data hygiene, accurate notes, and clear deal-stage tracking.

  • Exceptional Execution: Proven ability to run tight discovery calls, command proposal conversations, control the sales narrative, and push multi-stakeholder deals across the finish line.

  • Communication Excellence: Advanced English proficiency with exceptional presentation and relationship-building skills across phone, Zoom, email, and Slack.

Bonus Points

  • Experience using advanced outbound workflows or AI-driven discovery tools like Clay.

  • Familiarity with mid-market sales cycles (4–6 months) involving multi-stakeholder decision-making.

  • A background working within high-growth startup or fast-paced SMB environments.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Foundation: Holds a Bachelor’s degree (though we highly value proven sales grit and revenue results over formal education).

  • Targeted Industry Experience: Experience selling into Directors, CMOs, Growth, or Brand leaders—ideally within marketing, lead generation, digital acquisition, or performance models.

  • U.S. Market Exposure: Familiarity with U.S. business culture, the U.S. education/scholarship landscape, or holding a degree from a U.S.-based institution.

  • Strategic Traits: A natural curiosity to uncover deeper customer needs and the strategic thinking required to prioritize high-value enterprise or agency opportunities.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team. (Note: This role requires overlapping with standard U.S. working hours for client meetings).

  • High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

  • Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

  • Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

  • Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

  • Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

  • Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

  • Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. Your skillset:

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

We are building an accounting & finance software that will be industry-defining, and we need someone to help Rillet transition to the next company phase. We’ve grown quickly over the past few months and are expanding our GTM team to accelerate this trajectory. You’ll work directly with the CEO, the GTM, and the Product teams to help prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. As an early member of Rillet's GTM team, you’ll be uniquely positioned to build strategies, test hypotheses, and lay the foundation for Rillet’s GTM motion for the future.

We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.

What You'll Do

  • Remove technical objections
    You’ll play a key role in the sales cycle by addressing all technical questions of potential customers. Specifically, you’ll understand their business requirements and existing technology stack, clearly articulate how Rillet will be integrated, and improve their processes. You’ll take part in sales conversations and will be able to answer the vast majority of technical questions immediately, without the need to circle back with the Product team.

  • Perform sales demonstrations
    You’ll set up the sandbox environment and tailor the data to showcase each customer's key specific use cases. You’ll deliver high-impact demonstrations, answering questions along the way and adapting based on the customer’s needs. You’ll be their consultant in the purchase process.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in close to real-time. You will experiment with different demo styles, help write thoughtful follow-ups to customers, and become a highly responsive advisor to our prospective customers. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is delightful. You’re comfortable marketing to a user with high finance and accounting proficiency, and your knowledge about the domain will be furthered in the process.

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience, involving various accounting areas including revenue recognition, month-end close, and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 2+ years of experience supporting the sales cycle with implementation and/or customer support for accounting/financial solutions.

  • Excellent communicator who can make complex concepts easy to understand and knows how to write and speak conversationally.

  • Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment while keeping a high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit, a plus.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals in a fast-paced environment? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact; not just on your career, but on the world?

If so, we want to hear from you.

Where You’ll Make an Impact:

  • As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager and VP EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape.

  • You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

  • Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and value based selling techniques.

  • Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers.

  • Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential.

  • Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity.

  • Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite.

  • Represent Elliptic at key industry events and conferences to strengthen relationships and identify new prospects.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Mapped your territory, identified your top 20 target accounts, and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Identified upsell or cross-sell motion in an existing Elliptic account in your territory and have it actively in play to build a qualified pipeline of at least 2x of your quarterly quota through proactive whitespace mapping and engagement in collaboration with the Customer Success Managers.

  • Run complete discovery cycles with at least 10 prospects, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why.

  • Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full sales cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement.

  • Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account.

  • Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them.

You will be a great fit here if you are:

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

Bonus Points for:

  • An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space.

  • Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian.

  • A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus.

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Share Options

  • Holiday - 25 days

  • Private Health Insurance

  • Collaborative, flexible and friendly environment: We understand that flexibility is the key to maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • Social events, which include regular team lunch on us, quarterly full day events and an annual company 3-day event - this year these are taking place virtually

  • Personal training budget & LinkedIn Learning subscription

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). jobs.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
jobs.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:

  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy

jobs.title: (Senior) Associate Finance (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wer sind wir?

Gläser & Gehrmann — besondere Partner für besondere Herausforderungen. Wir sind eine Boutiqueberatung mit Sitz in Hamburg und einem zweiten Standort in Bremen und verbinden Mandate, wie man sie von den großen Häusern kennt, mit den kurzen Wegen einer kleinen Kanzlei. Unsere Kompetenzfelder liegen in den drei Bereichen Tax, Finance und Restructuring. Unser Profil liegt im interdisziplinären Zusammenspiel aus fachlichem Know-how und Inhouse-Kompetenz sowie im Restrukturierungs- und Insolvenzsteuerrecht — besonders in der Beratung mittelständischer und größerer Unternehmensmandate.

Aufgaben

Was gibt es zu tun?

Gemeinsam mit unserem Team unterstützt du mittelständische Unternehmen, Konzerne und Unternehmen in Sondersituationen bei herausfordernden Sachverhalten aus dem Bereich Finance. Auf diese Themen kannst du dich freuen:

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung oder Beratung anspruchsvoller Einzel- oder Konzernabschlüsse.
  • Du berätst Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um die IFRS.
  • Du begleitest mit deiner Expertise auch Unternehmen in der Krise, gegebenenfalls in Sanierungs-, Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzfällen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Unternehmensmandanten zusammen und unterstützt deren internes Rechnungswesen.

Qualifikation

Wen suchen wir?

Bei dir steht Finance für deutlich mehr als klassische WP-Themen wie die Jahresabschlussprüfung? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Zusätzlich würden wir uns freuen, wenn du dich in den folgenden Punkten zumindest ein Stück weit wiederfindest:

  • Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder rechnungslegungsbezogenen Beratung sammeln.
  • Du beschäftigst dich gerne mit herausfordernden Sachverhalten aus der internationalen Rechnungslegung, Konsolidierung oder Berichterstattung.
  • Du möchtest mehr als einen klassischen 0815-Job in der Wirtschaftsprüfung.
  • Du stehst neuen Technologien offen gegenüber und hast keine Angst vor Veränderungen.

Benefits

Was bieten wir?

Gute Arbeit wissen wir zu schätzen. Dementsprechend kannst du dich auf ein erstklassiges Grundeinkommen mit einem attraktiven Vergütungsmodell und Aufstiegschancen freuen. Das ist aber noch lange nicht alles:

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit direktem Mandantenkontakt und engagierten Karrierementoren.
  • Beste Rahmenbedingungen mit top Hard- und Softwareausstattung (DATEV, Office 365, Cloud, Laptop, Diensthandy) — damit die Arbeit gut von der Hand geht.
  • Übernahme sämtlicher Fort- und Weiterbildungskosten und aktive Unterstützung beim Berufsexamen — auch zeitlich und finanziell.
  • Eine Ermöglichungskultur, in der du dein Arbeitsumfeld von Beginn an mitgestaltest.
  • Regelmäßige und abwechslungsreiche Teamevents — unser Teamspirit will gepflegt werden.
  • Attraktive Nettolohnoptimierung (Benefits Card, Erholungsbeihilfe, Internetpauschale) — für mehr Netto vom Brutto.
  • Erstklassiges Grundeinkommen mit attraktivem Vergütungsmodell.
  • Büro und mobiles Arbeiten gehören bei uns selbstverständlich zusammen. Als Beratung mit hohem Projektanteil sind wir kein Nine-to-five-Betrieb — Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen oder im Jahresbonus berücksichtigt.

Wie bewirbst du dich?

Bewerben in drei Minuten? Kein Problem. Bewirb dich unkompliziert mit wenigen Klicks. Wir melden uns kurzfristig bei dir und freuen uns auf ein erstes Kennenlerngespräch.

jobs.description:
Most people don’t get real ownership until they’re years into their career. You’d get it in month one.

Cloud Studios is an independent product studio in Berlin. We turn sharp insights into digital products people need, then build the strongest ones - and the brands behind them - into independent companies.

Right now, we’re building across AI, consumer products and services, with our biggest current focus on a service helping brands understand and improve how they show up in AI recommendations.

You’d be building the media presence behind all of it, starting with the founder’s own.

This isn’t a “post more content” internship. You’ll take what’s actually happening inside the company - a product decision, client work, a raw idea, something we learned and turn it into content sharp enough to make someone stop scrolling.

You’ll work directly with the founder and have real influence over what we create, what gets published and how our content evolves.

Tasks

  • Grow the presence of the founder (Eli) and our brands, primarily across LinkedIn and Instagram
  • Create content across formats: posts, carousels, short-form video and more
  • Turn raw ideas, conversations and product updates into content worth watching or reading
  • Build a content waterfall system that turns one strong idea into multiple formats and channels
  • Shoot and edit short-form and behind-the-scenes content with the founder and team
  • Design visual content using Figma or Canva
  • Develop and improve our content templates and visual systems
  • Track what performs, kill what doesn’t and continuously test new ideas
  • Help turn attention into actual leads and business opportunities

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled at a university and the internship can be recognised as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) within your degree
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • You understand how LinkedIn and Instagram actually work
  • You can take a rough idea and turn it into something clear and engaging
  • You have good visual instincts and are comfortable using Figma or Canva
  • You’re proactive, reliable and comfortable taking ownership
  • You’re curious about AI, startups, brands and new tools
  • You care about the quality of what you put out

No years of marketing experience required. We care more about taste, initiative and whether you can turn ideas into finished work

Benefits

  • Real ownership from day one - not busywork!!!
  • Work directly with the founder and have a genuine say in what we build
  • Create content that actually gets published and impacts the business
  • Learn how founder-led marketing, content and lead generation work in practice
  • Build a content system around real products and customer work
  • Exposure to product, sales, growth and AI across multiple brands
  • Freedom to experiment with formats, tools and ideas
  • Build tangible work you can point to afterwards
  • Strong performance can create a serious path towards a longer-term paid role as the studio grows. This is your opportunity to take!
  • Hybrid work in Berlin (minimum 2 days in the Office, ideally more)
  • Flexible 20–40 hours/week, with full-time preferred

Skip the generic cover letter. We won’t read it.

We’d rather understand how you think and what you have good taste in.

Send us your answers for a few short questions below. Most importantly,if you have a portfolio, or something you’ve created that you’re genuinely proud of, we’d love to see it.

Important: This is an unpaid mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum). You must currently be enrolled at a university that can recognise the placement as a mandatory part of your degree, and be have the required visa status to work/intern in Germany.

jobs.description:
What you'll do

As a Solution Consultant for Snke Data, you will play a key role in accelerating the adoption of our Hospital Data Space (HDS) and HX Now solutions across Europe. Acting as the commercial product expert, you will work closely with customers, Account Managers and cross-functional teams to identify customer needs, develop solution strategies and drive successful business outcomes. You will bridge the gap between Sales, Product, Marketing and Delivery, ensuring that customer requirements are translated into compelling solutions and ultimately into successful implementations.

  • Partner with Account Managers throughout the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification and customer discovery to proposal development, tender participation and deal closure.
  • Engage with healthcare providers and stakeholders to understand clinical, operational, technical and strategic challenges and translate them into compelling solution concepts and customer value propositions.
  • Lead product presentations, demonstrations, workshops and solution discussions, effectively communicating technical capabilities and business benefits to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Act as the primary product expert for HDS and HX Now, providing guidance on use cases, integrations, data flows, information governance and solution architecture.
  • Support the development of customer proposals, business cases and tender responses, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, product capabilities and delivery scope.
  • Take ownership of product-related customer clarifications and coordinate input from Product Management, R&D, Professional Services, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure complete and consistent solutions.
  • Help assess opportunity potential, support forecasting activities and contribute directly to pipeline development and revenue growth through an individual sales quota.
  • Maintain deep market and product knowledge, including customer use cases, competitive developments, implementation approaches, product limitations and emerging healthcare data trends.
  • Provide feedback from customers and the market to Product Management and R&D, helping shape product enhancements, future requirements and go-to-market strategies.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on customer success stories, reference accounts, webinars, congresses, product messaging and sales enablement materials to strengthen market awareness and demand generation.
  • Ensure a structured handover from Sales to Delivery by documenting customer objectives, agreed scope, assumptions, dependencies, governance requirements, risks and implementation considerations.
  • Build and maintain reusable knowledge around customer requirements, integrations, use cases and best practices to support consistent product positioning across regions and market segments.


What we're looking for

You combine a strong Sales mindset preferred with a technical background, excellent communication skills and a high level of social competence. You enjoy working with customers, understanding complex challenges and translating them into clear and convincing solution concepts.

  • Professional experience in Solution Consulting, technical Sales, Pre-Sales, healthcare IT or digital health
  • A technical, healthcare IT, medical informatics, biomedical engineering or comparable background
  • A good understanding of hospital IT environments and clinical workflows
  • Knowledge of KIS/EHR, PACS, RIS, LIS and related hospital systems
  • Familiarity with interoperability concepts such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM and APIs
  • A clear commercial mindset and willingness to work toward an individual sales quota
  • Strong presentation, demonstration and workshop-facilitation skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • The ability to communicate confidently with clinicians, IT specialists, procurement teams, hospital management and executive stakeholders
  • A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented working style
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluency in German and English


Why Snke

  • A supportive, international team connected by shared values and a culture of trust
  • Meaningful responsibilities with a lasting impact on global healthtech, improving medical decisions and patient outcomes
  • 30 vacation days, plus December 24th and December 31st
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model within Germany
  • Bike leasing via our partner “BikeLeasing”
  • Parking garage and secure underground bike storage
  • Subsidized company restaurant and in-house café
  • Urban Sports Club membership with employer contribution
  • Regular after-work, team, and company events
  • Centrally located, modern workspace with a 212 m² rooftop terrace
