jobs.title: Procurement Director (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our powdered drinks HOLY Energy®, HOLY Hydration®, HOLY Iced Tea®, HOLY Milkshake® and HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

As Procurement Director, you will build one of HOLY's most important competitive advantages: a world-class supplier ecosystem that enables us to scale faster, improve margins and consistently deliver outstanding products to our customers.

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing
  • Develop category strategies that improve competitiveness, resilience and long-term scalability
  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering
  • Identify new sourcing opportunities, technologies and supplier capabilities to strengthen HOLY's competitive position
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans
  • Establish HOLY as a preferred customer through trust, transparency and professional supplier management
  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Strong track record of leading and developing teams 
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented team player to join FAIRR as an analyst within our Research and Data (R&D) team. In this role, you will be driving company-level research across our Protein Producer Index (PPI) and Seafood Index (SI). Our data-driven benchmarks help market participants to understand how companies are positioned to manage the risks and opportunities that lie within global food systems. In addition to owning a portfolio of companies, you will also be collaborating with FAIRR subject matter experts to develop sector and thematic research insights and feed into the product development cycle for our benchmarks. 


Key Outcomes & Accountabilities

  • ESG Data Analysis: Collect, analyse and score publicly available data and build a view on how companies manage material ESG risks and opportunities. Apply FAIRR’s methodology with accuracy and consistency, ensuring adherence to internal quality standards. 
  • Identification of ESG Risks, Opportunities and Trends: Translate raw data into actionable insights at the company level, highlighting emerging risks, opportunities, trends and progress relevant to food system sustainability. Draft structured outputs in different formats: summaries, data-driven reports, and briefing notes that are robust and well-evidenced. 
  • Company Dialogue: Lead constructive and informative conversations with companies during the research cycle, providing clear guidance to them on process, timelines, methodology and findings to support transparency and dialogue. 
  • Company Monitoring: Continuously monitor your portfolio of companies outside research cycles, tracking strategic changes, new initiatives, emerging risks, and controversies. 
  • Stakeholder Support: Act as a key point of contact for investor members, the media and other external stakeholders seeking deeper insights into company scores and benchmark assessments. 
  • Expertise Development: Continually deepen your subject-matter expertise in global food systems and/or specific areas of our research methodologies. 
  • Continuous Improvement: Work on the frontline of our research, acting as a key source of feedback on how our methodologies, products, processes and technological systems can be evolved over time to better meet market needs. 
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across FAIRR teams on an ad hoc and project-based basis. This may include responding to research requests, supporting the preparation of investor and corporate engagement, contributing analytical input to briefings and documents, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.


Technical Expertise & Role-Specific Capability

  • Passionate about Sustainability – you want to deepen your understanding of the risks and opportunities that exist within our terrestrial and marine food systems today.
  • Excellent research and analytical skills—both qualitative and quantitative—with strong attention to detail. Ability to identify relevant trends in large data sets and derive conclusions based on the analysis. 
  • Fluency in spoken and written English. Ability to draft written materials to a professional standard with minimal review and excellent verbal communications skills

  • Demonstrable experience of interacting and working with senior business professionals.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - DACH
jobs.description:
Build & Lead Our First Team in Region

This is a rare one: the chance to be the founding Sales Manager for Elliptic's DACH region. You won't be inheriting a team or a playbook — you'll be building both. If you want ownership over how a market gets built, not just a territory to run within someone else's structure, this is that role.

As Sales Manager, you'll be a foundational force in building and scaling both new logo acquisition and expansion across DACH. Leading a team of motivated quota-carrying Account Executives that you'll help hire and shape from day one, you'll be accountable for creating an elite sales culture, establishing sales discipline from scratch, and helping your team win complex enterprise deals across high-potential markets.

You will embody what it means to be a bar-raiser — not just holding high standards, but operationalizing them through coaching, process, and execution, in a region where you get to decide what "the way we do things" actually looks like.

What you will do:

Champion Elite Sales Execution

  • Lead from the front by coaching AEs through long, complex enterprise sales cycles — from outbound opportunity generation through to multi-threaded stakeholder engagement, PoCs, and contract negotiation

  • Reinforce a rigorous, AE-led approach to pipeline creation and account strategy

Drive and Scale New Logo Acquisition and Expansion

  • Build and execute the go-to-market strategy for DACH — breaking into high-value accounts across the crypto, fintech, financial services, and regulatory ecosystem

  • Forecast accurately, deliver against team quota, and maximise GTM efficiency in region

Embed Sales Rigour & Methodology

  • Roll out and reinforce powerful sales hygiene — from qualification and forecasting, to next-step discipline and CRM hygiene

  • Act as a process enabler, ensuring not just methodology knowledge, but mastery in execution underpinning MEDDPICC and Value-Based Selling

  • Leverage AI-powered sales tools to support qualification, pipeline health, and deal strategy execution

Coach, Develop & Elevate the Team

  • Continuously coach on core sales motions: outbound prospecting, access to power, objection handling, discovery quality, and deal closing

  • Provide real-time feedback via call coaching, pipeline reviews, and deal strategy sessions

  • Help AEs progress their careers while outperforming targets

  • Encourage the thoughtful application of AI tools within the sales process, fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

  • Incorporate AI-driven insights and capabilities into seller workflows to enhance productivity, improve win rates, and shorten sales cycles

Accelerate Strategic Proof-of-Concept Motions

  • Elevate the team's handling of Proofs of Concept and Trial cycles — ensuring AEs & SEs collaborate, and deliver customised demonstrations

  • Partner with pre-sales to deliver exceptional buying experiences

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Success

  • Steer/support the sales team in leading a cross-functional deal squad to ensure a smooth and high-velocity deal cycle

  • Feed voice-of-customer insights back into GTM leadership and Product — with an outsized voice given you're shaping how we enter this market

Build a High-Performance Culture

  • Create psychological safety and accountability through inclusion, transparency, and trust

  • Set the tone for excellence, energy, and ethical ambition — within your team and cross-regionally

  • Hire, onboard, and retain exceptional talent, building the DACH team from the ground up

  • Promote AI literacy and usage best practices across the team to drive innovation, reduce cognitive load, and support data-informed decision-making

You'll Thrive Here If You Have

  • Solid experience of B2B SaaS sales, with a strong bias toward enterprise and/or FI new business acquisition

  • 3-5 years of sales leadership experience, managing quota-carrying AEs in a high-growth, fast-paced GTM environment, with a strong track record of delivering against team quota

  • Proven, practical expertise in MEDDIC / MEDDPICC and Value Selling

  • A track record of leading high-performing teams that consistently meet and exceed quota targets

  • Hands-on experience managing AE-led outbound/prospecting motions, and coaching reps on breaking into cold accounts

  • Previous success running sales cycles that include Proof of Concept or Trial components

  • Excellence in pipeline hygiene, sales forecasting, and funnel management

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity, think cross-regionally, and scale what works — fast; you'll be writing the playbook, not just running it

  • A collaborative and growth-minded leadership style with strong cross-functional influence

  • A strong awareness of AI tools and techniques relevant to modern sales execution (e.g., conversation intelligence, sales enablement platforms, lead scoring) — and a willingness to coach reps on their effective, ethical use

  • Fluency in German and English

  • Strong interest or experience in digital assets

  • Bonus for candidates who have Web3 experience

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, are super intrigued by Crypto, and have an awesome mindset to learn — so if you don't meet all the criteria, still do apply!

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Share Options

  • Holiday - 25 days

  • Private Health Insurance

  • Collaborative, flexible and friendly environment: we understand that flexibility is the key to maintaining a healthy work-life balance

  • Social events, which include regular team lunches on us, quarterly full-day events and an annual company 3-day event

  • Personal training budget & LinkedIn Learning subscription

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it's important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don't all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

Funnels & Web

jobs.title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for an experienced Deployment Lead to guide complex customer implementations and help finance teams successfully transition onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone who has led ERP implementations and understands how to turn complex accounting and operational requirements into practical systems solutions. You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. You are comfortable owning multiple workstreams, advising senior stakeholders, and navigating the details of configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live.

You will combine strong implementation judgment with a customer-first mindset—bringing structure to ambiguity, identifying risks early, and keeping customers and internal teams moving toward a successful launch.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4–7 years in ERP implementation, systems consulting, or finance transformation (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is strongly preferred

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000
Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000
Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Knit - Research Manager
jobs.description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. National Security is a significant sector for Plexal’s Innovation Services business, where we enable our government clients’ adoption of new technology and create innovation ecosystems to enable their adaptation to the opportunity of disruptive and emerging technology. 
 
The Senior Customer Lead National Security is responsible for leading engagement with Plexal’s National Security clients in London and the adjacent region, building strategic partnerships to grow Plexal’s National Security business in region, evolving Plexal’s propositions and client offering in this market, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and success. This role sits in the wider National Security and Defence team, supporting the whole lifecycle of client engagement and delivery.  
 
The successful candidate will combine commercial capacity with government insight, helping Plexal to understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.


What You'll Do

  • Act as account lead for Plexal’s National Security clients located in London and the wider region, ensuring strong, resilient partnerships through the whole life cycle of Plexal’s client engagement from prospecting, proposal development, opportunity identification, and customer satisfaction in project delivery. Demonstrate highly visible presence with existing clients to augment Plexal’s brand and reputation.
  • Utilise engagement on client delivery to build highly effective client relationships that support Plexal’s account objectives. 
  • Drive net-new business in the customer base, leading a campaign of revenue diversification to broaden Plexal’s engagement across the client business units, and landing material value and duration contracts with the customer base.
  • Expand partnerships with the NS sector supplier base to deliver new revenue opportunities through partnership and new routes to market for Plexal.
  • Work alongside the wider NS and Defence team to develop, refine and market new propositions to Plexal’s NS clients, ensuring that Plexal is able to meet customer requirement and adapts to new opportunities in the NS market.
  • Contribute to the strategy and delivery of the NS & Defence team, providing expert insights into customer needs and procurement trends, and supporting NS&D strategic campaigns across the waterfront of client delivery.  
  • Be a valued contributor to the evolution of Plexal’s GTM function, supporting process improvements and maturation of business development.


Your Skills

  • Able to operate autonomously as an individual contributor, delivering against GTM objectives and targets. 
  • Accountable for personal delivery, and able to work collaboratively in a wider GTM team contributing to overall NS&D objectives. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, able to develop rapport and strong relationships with clients, understand client needs and align Plexal to deliver against them.
  • A strategic thinker, able to understand long-term trends in clients and develop credible Plexal propositions. 
  • A collaborative worker, with a strong bias to supporting and enabling broader teams (both GTM and London-based Plexal colleagues). 


Your Experience

Essential: 

  • Proven track record of selling, winning new business and proposition development in National Security
  • Demonstrable experience of working directly with National Security clients, especially those located in London, including demonstration of client delivery and relationship-based sales
  • Extant, valid SC (essential), DV (preferred). NS sponsorship preferred.
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of NS sector procurement and commercial processes.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
Desirable:
  • Experience of working on technology adoption, innovation ecosystems, or organisational change in government, especially National Security.
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 


Who You Are

Due to the nature of this position, our work and our client engagements, the post holder must be willing and eligible to achieve a minimum of SC clearance. Pre-existing SC clearance is welcome.


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.

jobs.title: Clinical Specialist - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
About us

Trexo Robotics is enabling mobility by building powered wearable robots. Our first product is a robot for children with movement disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, and it allows kids to walk, in many cases, for the first time in their lives. The device is currently being used by hundreds of families and the best hospitals across North America.

We are constantly working towards building mobility solutions for all. At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.

About the job

We are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.

As a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.

The role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. Occasional weekend work may be required for customer trials, roadshows or events. We will provide reasonable notice wherever possible.

What you'll do

  • Lead onboarding and hands-on training for new families and clinical partners receiving their Trexo devices.

  • Provide ongoing support to customers through regular check-ins, helping them use the device effectively and work towards meaningful goals.

  • Conduct hands-on Trexo trials with children and families at roadshows, conferences and other events across the UK and Europe.

  • Address daily customer queries via dedicated chat groups and manage support tickets.

  • Independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot the Trexo device, including basic technical, mechanical, and software checks.

  • Work with families and clinicians to establish meaningful goals and monitor relevant measures and progress.

  • Gather customer feedback to share with engineering and product teams to drive continuous product improvement.

  • Work closely with our global Customer Success and Sales teams to ensure a consistent customer experience.

  • Represent Trexo Robotics at clinical events, conferences and community-based activities.

About you

We are looking for a tech-savvy Physiotherapist who is comfortable working independently with advanced robotic equipment. You bring clinical credibility, strong emotional intelligence, and a practical approach to hands-on problem-solving. You thrive in community-based environments and enjoy traveling to work directly with children and their families.

You are practical and curious. You love asking 'why' multiple times until you understand something from first principles, and you thrive in unknown situations where you can apply logical reasoning, find solutions, and lead.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to use technology to improve mobility and quality of life for children.

Required Skills and Experience

  • At least 3 years' post-qualification experience working as a Physiotherapist or in a closely related clinical role.

  • Qualification as a Physiotherapist with current HCPC registration (or eligible to practice as a UK-licensed PT).

  • Clinical experience at a level broadly equivalent to NHS Band 6, or equivalent experience in private or independent practice.

  • Experience working in paediatric physiotherapy, ideally in a community-based setting.

  • Tech-savvy with the confidence to independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot technical equipment.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent empathy and patience.

  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 75% travel across the UK and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe.

  • Ability to safely lift and handle equipment weighing up to 27 kg (60 lb).

  • Hold a valid UK driving licence.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working within the NHS.

  • Membership of the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP).

  • Experience providing virtual care, telehealth or remote clinical support.

  • Familiarity with UK paediatric funding pathways, such as NHS Continuing Healthcare, Personal Health Budgets, Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs) or charitable funding.

  • Experience working with children with complex mobility needs, neurological conditions or physical disabilities.

  • Experience with assistive technology, rehabilitation technology, robotics, orthotics or other mobility devices.

  • Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French.

  • Experience using tools such as Salesforce or Airtable.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Employee stock options

  • Home Office Setup allowance

  • Car allowance

  • Private health insurance

Interview process

  • Screening (30 mins)

  • Hiring Manager conversation (60 mins)

  • Team and founder conversations (30 mins each)

  • Reference and background check

  • Offer

Work Authorization: Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support work authorization applications. We can only consider candidates who already have the legal right to work in the location they are applying for.

AI in Recruitment: At Trexo Robotics, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support our recruitment process. AI helps with tasks like resume screening, drafting job descriptions, creating interview questions, and occasionally sourcing candidates. Final hiring decisions are always made by our team. Our goal is to use AI responsibly to streamline administrative tasks, improve candidate experience, and maintain fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with industry standards.

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten dich bei uns

  • Sorge dafür, dass wir die richtigen Dinge messen: Gemeinsam mit Produkt, Redaktion und Engineering entwickelst Du Tracking- und Messkonzepte, definierst relevante Kennzahlen und stellst sicher, dass die benötigten Daten vollständig, verständlich und verlässlich zur Verfügung stehen.
